paragraphs.text: Assume the readout is locally unbiased at every possible $x$ and the future noise is independent of the storage history. Conditional on that history, the readout error then has mean zero. Since $s$ is fixed by the history, $\mathbb E[se]=\mathbb E[s\,\mathbb E(e\mid\text{storage history})]=0$. Both errors have zero mean, so their covariance vanishes. Translation invariance makes the readout variance the same at every $x$; denote it by $V_{\mathrm{read}}(L)$.
